mapper.select: /** * selectWorkHrPreconDetail : isry.couns.mngr.workaltmntmng.mapper.WorkHrPreconMapper : 그리드 근무시간 상세 조회 * 작성자 : Jeong.Won.Je */ WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AS BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO , CRTR_YM AS CRTR_YM , BGNG_HR || '~' || END_HR AS TIMES FROM AYC110 /* 근무배정표_월별 */ WHERE 1=1 AND CRTR_YM LIKE #{crtrYm}||'%' AND TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{instNo} ) , YY AS ( SELECT T1.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AS BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO , T1.USER_ID AS USER_ID FROM AYC100 T1 /* 근무배정표_일별 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T1.USER_ID = #{userId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM AYC130 WHERE USER_ID = T1.USER_ID AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND APLY_SE_CD = '01' AND APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND T1.WORK_YMD BETWEEN VCATN_BGNG_YMD AND VCATN_END_YMD ) ) SELECT ZZ.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AS BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO , ZZ.CRTR_YM AS CRTR_YM , ZZ.TIMES AS TIMES , COUNT(YY.USER_ID) AS USER_ID_CNT , YY.USER_ID AS USER_ID FROM ZZ LEFT OUTER JOIN YY ON ZZ.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = YY.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO GROUP BY ZZ.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO, ZZ.CRTR_YM, ZZ.TIMES, YY.USER_ID ORDER BY ZZ.CRTR_YM, ZZ.TIMES ASC

/** * selectWorkHrPreconDetail : isry.couns.mngr.workaltmntmng.mapper.WorkHrPreconMapper : 그리드 근무시간 상세 조회 * 작성자 : Jeong.Won.Je */ WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AS BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO , CRTR_YM AS CRTR_YM , BGNG_HR || '~' || END_HR AS TIMES FROM AYC110 /* 근무배정표_월별 */ WHERE 1=1 AND CRTR_YM LIKE #{crtrYm}||'%' AND TASKWK_TYPE_DEPT_CD = #{instNo} ) , YY AS ( SELECT T1.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AS BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO , T1.USER_ID AS USER_ID , T3.FLNM_ENCPT AS FLNM FROM AYC100 T1 /* 근무배정표_일별 */ , SAA200 T2 /* 사용자 */ , SCA100 T3 /* 종사자 */ WHERE 1=1 AND T1.USER_ID = T2.USER_ID AND T2.ENFSN_NO = T3.ENFSN_NO AND T1.USER_ID = #{userId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT * FROM AYC130 WHERE USER_ID = T1.USER_ID AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND APLY_SE_CD = '01' AND APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND T1.WORK_YMD BETWEEN VCATN_BGNG_YMD AND VCATN_END_YMD ) ) SELECT YY.USER_ID AS USER_ID , YY.FLNM AS FLNM , ZZ.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO AS BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO , ZZ.CRTR_YM AS CRTR_YM , ZZ.TIMES AS TIMES , COUNT(YY.USER_ID) AS USER_ID_CNT FROM ZZ LEFT OUTER JOIN YY ON ZZ.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO = YY.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO GROUP BY ZZ.BIZ_PLAN_MNG_NO, ZZ.CRTR_YM, ZZ.TIMES, YY.USER_ID, YY.FLNM ORDER BY ZZ.CRTR_YM, ZZ.TIMES ASC
